name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2026-02-20, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.31 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
